spine: 1. 謎題：Ray 訓練 job 一再因 ENA 網卡 reset 而 crash，但整機 perf 看不出 CPU 異常——『整體健康』與『持續出事』兩個事實無法並存。
2. 量測粒度的切換是第一個突破：mpstat 逐核（每秒一次、連續一小時）才看見 CPU 39 連續數秒 100% system CPU，且總在 reset 之前；aggregate 把它平均掉了。
3. 排除法收斂搜索空間：H1 記憶體配置（THP／jemalloc，CPU 有降但 reset 還在）、H2 資源競爭（taskset／中斷 pinning，Nothing worked）、H3 硬體壞批（AZ 差異是設定假象、AWS 確認非其問題）、H4 訓練容器 crash（沒查到）全部出局。
4. 時間旅行式 profiling 逼出真相：perf 以 2 分鐘為單位錄 360 次（涵蓋約 12 小時），用 Flamescope 倒帶到 reset 前兩分鐘，看到 kubelet 佔整機 ~6.5% CPU、全花在 mem_cgroup_nr_lru_pages。
5. 殭屍 cgroup：/proc/cgroups 追蹤 68,680 個 memory cgroup，但 /sys/fs/cgroup 實際只有 240 個；源頭是 DLAMI 預設啟動、卻因無權限加入 ECS cluster 而反覆 crash 的 ecs-agent，每次 crash 留下不被回收的 cgroup。
6. 修法與效果：關掉 ECS agent systemd unit + 重開機清殭屍；cgroup 數量穩定、訓練成功率回升（先前某些 use case 掉超過 25%），reboot 只能撐約一週因累積是漸進的。
7. 方法論教訓：aggregate 會把單點問題平均掉；指標改善 ≠ 找到病因；間歇故障靠連續 profiling 倒帶；殭屍洩漏用 kernel 計數對實際目錄數一個減法驗出。

perspective.mechanism: kernel 追蹤的 memory cgroup 不會隨容器消失自動回收；當數量累積到數萬，任何要遍歷所有 cgroup 的 kernel 路徑（如 kubelet 觸發的 mem_cgroup_nr_lru_pages）就會把單核餵滿，餓死排到同核的網路 driver thread，最終觸發 ENA reset。
perspective.tradeoff: 用通用 base image（DLAMI）省去自建映像的成本，代價是繼承了一個用不到、卻會持續 crash 並洩漏 cgroup 的 systemd unit；aggregate 監控指標省觀測成本，代價是把單核病灶平均掉、看不見。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣 SRE／平台工程師遇到間歇性、跨機器、無人背鍋的故障時，先用 mpstat 看逐核 system CPU，再拿 cat /proc/cgroups 的計數對 find /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/ -type d | wc -l，差一個數量級即為 cgroup 洩漏；間歇故障用連續 perf + Flamescope 倒帶。

notes.quote: their distributed training jobs were seeing intermittent loss of network connectivity, and that ultimately caused their jobs to crash
notes.interpretation: 故障的外在症狀：Ray 分散式訓練 job 間歇性斷網並 crash，是整個調查的起點。

notes.quote: sometimes, a single CPU core (in the following screenshot, CPU 39) was often using 100% of its system CPU for multiple seconds!
notes.interpretation: 逐核量測的關鍵發現：單一核心 CPU 39 連續數秒把 system CPU 吃到 100%；這是 aggregate 視角看不到的。

notes.quote: the overall perf view told us very little about what was happening in each individual core
notes.interpretation: 整機 perf 視角的盲點：把所有核心平均掉，掩蓋了單核問題——誤導性指標。

notes.quote: mpstat to get an overview of per core utilization on a per-second basis for an hour
notes.interpretation: 揭露真相的量測方法與粒度：mpstat 逐核、每秒一次、連續一小時。

notes.quote: We tried using Huge pages (by turning on TransparentHugePages) to reduce page faulting ... experimented with more efficient memory allocators like jemalloc
notes.interpretation: 假設一的測法：開 THP、換 jemalloc，方向是壓低 page fault 帶來的 system CPU。

notes.quote: While we saw some drops in overall CPU utilization and page faulting from the memory allocators and huge pages settings, the network resets continued.
notes.interpretation: 假設一被排除的關鍵：指標真的改善了，但 reset 沒停——改善與病因無關。

notes.quote: We tried to give the training jobs their own CPU cores by providing them CPU affinity via taskset ... played with interrupt pinning for ENA drivers by steering network interrupts to other cores. Nothing worked.
notes.interpretation: 假設二（資源競爭）的測法與結果：taskset affinity + 中斷 pinning，全失效。引號內『Nothing worked』為原文。

notes.quote: the issue was definitely not on the AWS side
notes.interpretation: 假設三（硬體）部分排除：AWS support 確認問題不在 AWS 側；AZ 差異後證實是設定假象。

notes.quote: Ran perf recordings in 2 minute increments ... Executed this 360 times to cover roughly a 12 hour period of profiles
notes.interpretation: 可重現實驗的量測設計：perf 每 2 分鐘錄一次、共 360 次、涵蓋約 12 小時——時間旅行式 profiling 的素材。

notes.quote: the kubelet, our lightweight Kubernetes agent, was occupying ~6.5% of total CPU usage a few seconds before an ENA reset ... the kubelet was spending a lot of time on a system call: mem_cgroup_nr_lru_pages
notes.interpretation: Flamescope 倒帶看到的熱點：kubelet 在 reset 前佔整機 ~6.5% CPU，全花在 mem_cgroup_nr_lru_pages 這個 system call。

notes.quote: Nearly 70,000 memory cgroups tracked in the Kernel but only 240 actually in use. cat /proc/cgroups | grep memory | awk '{print $3}' -> 68680 ; find /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/ -type d | wc -l -> 240
notes.interpretation: 殭屍 cgroup 的決定性證據：kernel 追蹤 68,680 個 memory cgroup，實際只用 240 個。兩個指令與數字皆為原文。

notes.quote: We were leveraging the AWS Deep Learning AMI (Ubuntu 20.04) as a base machine image and it set up ecs-agent as a default systemd unit ... it also started the ECS Agent, which over several days of crashing accumulated a massive amount of memory cgroups ... was correctly crashing since we did not give our machines permissions to join an ECS cluster
notes.interpretation: 根因來源：DLAMI 預設把 ecs-agent 設成 systemd unit；機器無權限加入 ECS cluster，agent 持續 crash，好幾天下來累積大量 memory cgroup。

notes.quote: We fixed the issue by simply turning off the ECS agent systemd unit in our base images and rebooting all our machines to purge the zombie memcgs ... we noticed that memory cgroups remained stable
notes.interpretation: 修法與直接效果：關掉 ECS agent systemd unit + 重開機清殭屍 memcg；之後 cgroup 數量穩定。
故障的業務衝擊量化：某些 use case 的成功率掉超過 25%；修好後訓練回到高成功率。

notes.quote: Rebooting reset the memcg counts! ... at approximately one week of uptime, after which the network resets returned on the rebooted machines
notes.interpretation: 為什麼 reboot 只是暫時緩解：重開機把 memcg 計數清零，但約一週 uptime 後 reset 又回來——累積是漸進的。

notes.quote: TX q 5 is paused for too long (threshold 5000000)
notes.interpretation: ENA reset 的觸發訊息：某傳送佇列被卡太久超過門檻，驅動重置網卡。為原文日誌訊息。

notes.quote: a different URL caused a last step that emitted a metric to fail and caused the node bootstrap script to get marked as failed. This prevented the ECS agent from starting up
notes.interpretation: AZ 差異假象的解釋：某 AZ 的 bootstrap 因 URL 不同讓 metric 上報失敗、script 被標失敗，反而擋掉 ECS agent 啟動——所以該 AZ 看起來健康。
工具：Netflix 的 Flamescope 提供時間旅行式的 CPU stack 視角，可放大到 reset 前後的時間窗。

claims.claim_text: 他們用 Ray 跑的分散式訓練 job「會間歇性地失去網路連線，最終導致 job crash」
claims.evidence: their distributed training jobs were seeing intermittent loss of network connectivity, and that ultimately caused their jobs to crash
claims.note: 原文症狀陳述，斷言式；post 引號內容與原文一致。

claims.claim_text: reset 的日誌訊息是 TX q 5 is paused for too long (threshold 5000000)
claims.evidence: TX q 5 is paused for too long (threshold 5000000). Time since last napi 6596000 usec.
claims.note: log 訊息逐字相符（post 只引到 threshold 部分，為原文前段）。

claims.claim_text: 有一顆核心（截圖裡是 CPU 39）「經常連續好幾秒把它的 system CPU 用到 100%」
claims.location: H2「謎題：整機 CPU 正常」段後
claims.evidence: a single CPU core (in the following screenshot, CPU 39) was often using 100% of its system CPU for multiple seconds!
claims.note: 核心編號、100%、連續數秒三項皆相符，斷言式。

claims.claim_text: 整機的 perf 視角「對於每一顆核心各自發生了什麼，幾乎什麼都沒告訴我們」
claims.evidence: an overall perf view told us very little about what was happening in each individual core
claims.note: 原文因 96 vCPU 而 overall perf 看不出單核；post 翻譯忠實。

claims.claim_text: 團隊改用 mpstat，以「每秒一次、連續一小時」的方式記錄每顆核心各自的使用率
claims.location: H2 謎題段 mpstat 突破
claims.evidence: we used mpstat to get an overview of per core utilization on a per-second basis for an hour
claims.note: 工具、逐核、每秒、一小時皆相符。

claims.claim_text: 打開 Transparent Huge Pages「來減少 page faulting」，並且「試了像 jemalloc 這種更有效率的記憶體配置器」
claims.evidence: We tried using Huge pages (by turning on TransparentHugePages) to reduce page faulting. We experimented with more efficient memory allocators like jemalloc
claims.note: 兩項測法與原文逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 「我們確實從記憶體配置器和 huge pages 的設定上，看到整體 CPU 使用率和 page faulting 有一些下降。」「然而網路 reset 還在繼續發生。」
claims.evidence: While we saw some drops in overall CPU utilization and page faulting from the memory allocators and huge pages settings, the network resets continued.
claims.note: 原文一句包含『有下降』與『reset 繼續』兩半，post 拆引但語意一致；無 hedge 上修。

claims.claim_text: 「試著用 taskset 給訓練 job 它們自己的 CPU 核心（CPU affinity）」、「玩了 ENA driver 的中斷 pinning，把網路中斷導到其他核心去」，結果「Nothing worked.」
claims.evidence: We tried to give the training jobs their own CPU cores by providing them CPU affinity via taskset. Out of desperation, we played with interrupt pinning for ENA drivers by steering network interrupts to other cores. Nothing worked.
claims.note: 三段測法與『Nothing worked』逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 找上 AWS support，得到的結論是「這個問題絕對不在 AWS 那一側」；AWS support 也介入並確認問題不在 AWS 那一側
claims.location: 開篇與 H2 假設三段
claims.evidence: After several engagements, were convinced that the issue was definitely not on the AWS side.
claims.note: 原文『definitely not on the AWS side』與 post 引號相符。

claims.claim_text: 讓 perf「以兩分鐘為單位」連續錄製……整套跑「360 次」，「涵蓋大約 12 小時的 profile」
claims.evidence: ran perf in 2 minute increments ... Running this 360 times covers roughly a 12 hour period of profiles
claims.note: 2 分鐘、360 次、約 12 小時三項數字皆相符。

claims.claim_text: Flamescope（Netflix 的工具，原文形容它提供一種「time travel view」的 CPU stack 視角）
claims.evidence: we ... visualized it with the excellent Flamescope tool, courtesy our friends at Netflix. Flamescope allows us to view a 2 minute CPU stack with a time travel view
claims.note: 『time travel view』與 Netflix 出處皆在原文。

claims.claim_text: 「kubelet——我們那個輕量的 Kubernetes agent——佔了整機 CPU 約 6.5%」；kubelet「花了大量時間在一個 system call 上：mem_cgroup_nr_lru_pages」
claims.evidence: the kubelet was occupying ~6.5% of total CPU usage a few seconds before an ENA reset... the kubelet was spending a lot of time on a system call: mem_cgroup_nr_lru_pages.
claims.note: ~6.5%、reset 前、mem_cgroup_nr_lru_pages 皆相符。

claims.claim_text: kernel 裡追蹤著「將近七萬個 memory cgroup，但實際在用的只有 240 個」；指令 cat /proc/cgroups -> 68680、find /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/ -> 240
claims.location: H2「解決」段與 pre 區塊
claims.evidence: Nearly 70,000 memory cgroups tracked in the Kernel but only 240 actually in use. cat /proc/cgroups | grep memory | awk '{print $3}' 68680 ... find /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/ -type d | wc -l 240
claims.note: 68680、240、兩個指令皆與原文逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: Pinterest「用 AWS Deep Learning AMI（Ubuntu 20.04）當基礎機器映像，而它預設把 ecs-agent 設成一個 systemd unit」；ECS Agent「在我們沒給機器加入 ECS cluster 的權限的情況下，理所當然地一直 crash」；「好幾天下來，累積出大量的 memory cgroup」
claims.evidence: we were leveraging the AWS Deep Learning AMI (Ubuntu 20.04) as a base machine image and it set up ecs-agent as a default systemd unit ... it also started the ECS Agent, which over several days of crashing accumulated a massive amount of memory cgroups ... The ECS Agent was correctly crashing since we did not give our machines permissions to join an ECS cluster
claims.note: DLAMI Ubuntu 20.04、systemd unit、無 ECS 權限、好幾天累積皆相符。

claims.claim_text: 「我們就只是在 base image 裡把 ECS agent 的 systemd unit 關掉，然後重開所有機器來清掉殭屍 memcg。」之後「memory cgroup 數量就穩定下來了」
claims.evidence: We fixed the issue by simply turning off the ECS agent systemd unit in our base images and rebooting all our machines to purge the zombie memcgs. After this... memory cgroups remained stable
claims.note: 修法與『cgroup 數量穩定』皆相符。

claims.claim_text: 在修好之前，某些 use case 曾經出現「成功率掉超過 25%」
claims.evidence: some use cases with > 25% Success Rate drop
claims.note: > 25% 成功率下降與原文相符。

claims.claim_text: reboot 把計數清零，但約一週 uptime 後 reset 又回來（重開機只能撐約一週）
claims.location: 因果鏈 figure 與「解決」段
claims.evidence: Rebooting reset the memcg counts! ... at approximately one week of uptime, after which the network resets returned on the rebooted machines
claims.note: 重開機清零、約一週後復發皆相符。

claims.claim_text: 某個 AZ 的開機腳本因為一個不同的 URL 讓最後一步 metric 上報失敗、整個 script 被標成失敗，反而擋掉了那顆殭屍的源頭（ECS agent 啟動）
claims.evidence: the difference in URLs caused a last step that emitted a metric to fail and caused the node bootstrap script to get marked as failed. This prevented the ECS agent from starting up because its systemd unit depended on the bootstrap script to successfully complete
claims.note: 不同 URL → metric 失敗 → script 標失敗 → 擋掉 ECS agent，因果鏈與原文相符。

claims.claim_text: 遍歷成本與 cgroup 數量成正比、從 240 漲到 68,680 等於把同一個迴圈放大將近三百倍（線性累積、300x）
claims.location: H2「解決」段殭屍化機制段與 range widget caption
claims.note: post 明確標記為推斷：『原文只給了 68,680 與 240 兩個數字……遍歷成本與數量成正比是依此推斷』、widget caption『線性累積為合理的推測』。屬作者標記的合成，原文未直接斷言，標記合規。

claims.claim_text: ENA driver 的『卡太久就重置』機制：driver 工作排不到被佔滿的 CPU，傳送佇列被暫停太久，驅動於是判定網卡卡死把它重置（CPU 飢餓 → ENA reset 的下游機制）
claims.location: 開篇機制段與因果鏈 figure
claims.evidence: the kubelet was occupying ~6.5% of total CPU usage a few seconds before an ENA reset ... TX q 5 is paused for too long (threshold 5000000)
claims.note: CPU 飢餓導致 TX queue paused 進而 reset 的因果，由 n10（reset 前 CPU 熱點）與 n16（paused too long 訊息）共同支撐；post 將機制鋪陳更白話但未上修強度。
